events.name: Bash
events.head: Check Adi test attendee and Tantra key env names
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/centre_admin.py GET '/admin/api/attendees?q=[email]' 2>&1 | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);r=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('attendees',d.get('items',[]));[print(a.get('id'),a.get('name'),a.get('email'),a.get('whatsapp'),a.get('test'),a.get('revoked')) for a in r if a.get('id')==127 or (a.get('name')=='Adi test')][:12]" 2>&1|head; set -a; . ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env 2>/dev/null; set +a; env | grep -o '^TANTRA[A-Z_]*' | head
